prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished approval design board containing TWO complete Rakky Ride mobile screens side by side at equal scale, with a small neutral gap and quiet neutral outer background. Left is a completed ride receipt; right is the details of an unsuccessful request. No phone hardware, hands, perspective, photo, map, or artwork. Both full screens must have visible bottom safe areas. These are two states of the same page, not two competing designs.
Match the approved compact Ride history style: white surfaces, forest green #176B17, pale mint #EAF5E5, silver #EEF1EC, charcoal #141A14 text, gray #586253 metadata, subtle thin borders, 12-16 logical px corners, 16-18px conventional line icons, a small standard green sedan. Inter-like typography. Main page titles only 15-16 logical px, all content 13-14 logical px, amount no larger than 17 logical px. No big hero price or headline, no oversized icon. Aim for a very clean realistic implementable ride-hailing app UI with concise copy.

LEFT SCREEN, exact content:
Compact status bar and back-arrow circle with header "Trip receipt".
Small date line "20 Oct 2026 · 11:42 AM".
A compact pale mint summary panel with small car symbol, green text badge "Completed", medium label "Trip fare", amount "₦3,500", and small line "Cash payment".
A clean route section with small circle and pin icons, a fine connecting line, labels "Pickup" and "Destination", addresses on separate lines: "Allen Avenue, Ikeja" and "Ikeja City Mall, Alausa".
A compact two-column facts row: "Est. distance" / "12.5 km", and "Est. duration" / "28 min".
A small driver/vehicle information section: label "Driver", value "Alex O."; label "Vehicle", value "Toyota Corolla"; label "Plate number", value "LAG 123 XY". Use small conventional person and car symbols if helpful, no photograph or rating.
A quiet last metadata row: "Trip ID", "7f3a9c12…3378a918".
A subtle green text link near the bottom "Help & support".
Normal bottom safe area and gesture bar.

RIGHT SCREEN, exact content:
Identical compact status bar and back-arrow circle with header "Trip details".
Date line "20 Oct 2026 · 10:18 AM".
A compact light neutral summary panel with small car symbol, amber text badge "No drivers found", clear medium-weight label "Not charged", and ONE short explanation "This request did not become a trip."
The same route section with labels "Pickup" and "Destination", addresses "Lekki Phase 1" and "Victoria Island".
A concise bordered or divided details section with two aligned rows: "Original estimate" value "₦3,500"; "Payment method" value "Cash".
Then a small row "Driver" value "Not assigned".
A quiet metadata row: "Trip ID", "ab42d610…028fc912".
The same subtle text link "Help & support", and bottom safe area with gesture bar.
The original estimate on the right must look like low-emphasis historical metadata, not a charged total; it must never appear underneath a label implying paid or charged. No false refund claims.

Do not invent fee breakdowns, taxes, discount lines, ratings, driver arrival times, download buttons or share buttons. Avoid redundant repeated explanations. Keep all cards and fields comfortably within each screen, with plenty of breathing room but compact content. Use exact supplied text. Every address, person, plate, ID and fare is fictitious sample UI data; no real user's screenshot or records are used. Small headings OUTSIDE the screens may say only "Completed ride" and "Unsuccessful request".
